name: AOBS Cloud
value: A control room that lives in the cloud, so the show can be produced from anywhere.
intro: AOBS Cloud is our platform for **cloud esports production**. Sources come in from wherever they are, the show is switched and encoded in the cloud, and the programme goes out to every platform.
features: Remote production without a venue build or travel days
Game feeds, casters and graphics contributed over the internet
Programme encoded once and delivered to Twitch, YouTube and Kick
Pairs with Backup Streamer for a second, always-ready path

name: OBS Plugins
value: The tools OBS does not ship with, written by the crew that needed them on air.
intro: We build our own **OBS plugins for esports** broadcasts. When a show needs something OBS cannot do out of the box, we write it, test it on real productions and keep it in our toolkit.
features: Purpose-built for live esports production workflows
Connects OBS to live game data for automatic graphics
Developed and maintained in-house by AOBS
Battle-tested on our own tournament broadcasts

name: Backup Streamer
value: If the primary signal fails, the backup takes over. The stream never goes down.
intro: Backup Streamer is our **stream backup and failover** system. A second path runs alongside the primary for the whole show. When the primary drops, the backup is already there, and viewers stay on a live channel instead of an offline screen.
features: A hot backup path running for the entire broadcast
Automatic takeover when the primary signal fails
The channel stays live, so viewers and sponsors stay on screen
Works with AOBS Cloud and on-site productions
